question: Who gives us bright light in the day? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! God made the bright Sun to give us warm light every day! ☀️
hint: It is big, yellow, and very hot!

question: What twinkles in the sky at night? ✨
explanation: Great job! Stars look like tiny diamonds in the beautiful night sky! ✨
hint: They shine in the dark.

question: What beautiful thing do birds do? 🐦
explanation: Super! We thank God for giving birds wings to fly high in the sky! 🐦
hint: They use their wings to move.

question: Who cooks yummy food for us? 🍲
explanation: Wonderful! We are grateful for our parents who make delicious food for us! 🥘
hint: They love you and care for you.

question: What is a sweet word to say to God? 🙏
explanation: Fantastic! We always say 'Thank you' to God for our beautiful world! 🙏
hint: It is a magic word.

question: What do we use to see the world? 👀
explanation: Awesome! God gave us two bright eyes to see everything around us! 👀
hint: You use them to read this.

question: What do we use to hear sweet songs? 👂
explanation: Great job! We use our ears to listen to music and birds singing! 🎶
hint: You have one on each side of your head.

question: What has a very sweet smell? 🌸
explanation: Super! Flowers smell very sweet and make the garden look pretty! 🌷
hint: Bees love them.

question: Who brings us cool and fresh rain? 🌧️
explanation: Wonderful! Clouds bring water so plants and trees can grow big! ☔
hint: They float in the sky.

question: What keeps our body strong and healthy? 🥗
explanation: Awesome! Thank God for the yummy and healthy food we eat every day! 🍛
hint: You eat it when you are hungry.

question: Who plays fun games with us? ⚽
explanation: Great job! We thank God for kind friends who share and play with us! 🎈
hint: You meet them at school and in the park.

question: What do tall trees give us on a hot day? 🌳
explanation: Super! Big green trees give us cool shade when the sun is very hot! 🌳
hint: It keeps us away from direct sunlight.

question: When should we pray to God? 🙏
explanation: Fantastic! We pray every day to say thank you for all our blessings! 🙏
hint: We do this in the morning and at night.

question: Where do beautiful little fish swim? 🐟
explanation: Awesome! God made water for fish to swim and live happily! 🌊
hint: It is wet and clear.

question: What gives us soft and gentle light at night? 🌙
explanation: Great job! The Moon glows beautifully in the dark sky! 🌙
hint: It is white and changes shape.

question: How does the morning breeze feel? 🌬️
explanation: Super! The gentle wind feels very fresh and makes us happy! 🌬️
hint: It gently blows through your hair.

question: Who holds our hand and helps us grow safely? 🤝
explanation: Wonderful! We thank God for loving parents who care for us! ❤️
hint: They live in your house with you.

question: What do we use to run fast and jump high? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! We have strong legs to run, walk, and jump playfully! 🏃‍♀️
hint: They have feet at the bottom.

question: What do we use to clap nicely for our friends? 👏
explanation: Great job! We use our hands to work, eat, and clap happily! 🙌
hint: They have ten fingers.

question: Who made this big and beautiful green world? 🌍
explanation: Super! God created the trees, animals, and this whole beautiful world! 🌎
hint: We pray to Him every day.

question: What color is the bright shining Sun? 💛
explanation: Fantastic! The Sun is yellow, bright, and gives us beautiful light! 💛
hint: It is the color of a banana.

question: What is tall, green, and full of moving leaves? 🌿
explanation: Awesome! Trees give us clean air, shade, and sweet fruits! 🍏
hint: Birds build nests in it.

question: Who sings sweet songs early in the morning? 🎶
explanation: Great job! God gave birds beautiful voices to sing sweet songs! 🎵
hint: They live in nests.

question: How do we feel when we sing a lovely prayer? 🎵
explanation: Super! Praying to God makes our hearts feel light and happy! ❤️
hint: You smile when you feel this way.

question: What color is the beautiful open sky above us? 🖌️
explanation: Wonderful! The wide open sky is blue and looks very beautiful! 🌤️
hint: It is the color of the ocean.

question: What do we drink when we feel thirsty? 🥛
explanation: Awesome! God gives us fresh water to drink and stay very healthy! 🚰
hint: It has no color and no taste.

question: Who keeps us safe and warm in our home? 🏠
explanation: Great job! We love and thank our family for keeping us safe! 🥰
hint: It includes your mom and dad.

question: What gives us sweet and juicy fruits to eat? 🍎
explanation: Super! Trees are amazing gifts that give us tasty apples and mangoes! 🥭
hint: They have deep roots in the ground.

question: What part of the body helps us smell nice flowers? 👃
explanation: Fantastic! We use our nose to breathe air and smell fresh flowers! 🌸
hint: It is right in the middle of your face.

question: What sweet and sticky thing do bees make for us? 🐝
explanation: Awesome! Little bees work very hard to make delicious honey for us! 🐝
hint: It is yellow, sticky, and very sweet.

question: What beautiful colors do we see in the sky after rain? 🌈
explanation: Great job! God paints the sky with a beautiful rainbow after the rain! 🌦️
hint: It has seven bright colors.

question: What falls gently from the dark rainy clouds? ☔
explanation: Super! Raindrops fall from the sky to give water to the trees! 🌧️
hint: They are small drops of water.

question: What do happy dogs do to say hello to us? 🐕
explanation: Wonderful! Dogs wag their tails to show they love us and are happy! 🐶
hint: They move the back part of their body.

question: What do we use to give everyone a big happy smile? 😁
explanation: Awesome! We thank God for our lips to speak kind words and smile! 😊
hint: They are a part of your mouth.

question: What is this beautiful round Earth to us? 🌎
explanation: Great job! The Earth is our beautiful home, full of animals and plants! 🌍
hint: We all live here.

question: What do pretty butterflies do in the colorful garden? 🦋
explanation: Super! God gave butterflies beautiful wings to flutter from flower to flower! 🌸
hint: They fly very gently.

question: What do we say to God for all our fun toys? 🪁
explanation: Fantastic! We always say 'Thank you' for our nice toys and happy games! 🧸
hint: It shows we are happy to have them.

question: What do we cheerfully say when we wake up early? 🌅
explanation: Awesome! Starting the day with 'Good morning' makes everyone smile! 🌞
hint: We say this when the sun rises.

question: What makes the green garden look so beautiful? 🌷
explanation: Great job! Colorful flowers make our world look very pretty and bright! 🌺
hint: They have nice petals and smell good.

question: Who teaches us very good things at school? 📚
explanation: Super! We are thankful for our teachers who help us learn and grow! 🏫
hint: They stand near the blackboard.

question: What helps the little boats sail smoothly on the water? ⛵
explanation: Wonderful! The invisible wind pushes the boats gently across the water! 🌊
hint: You cannot see it, but you can feel it.

question: What covers the ground outside like a soft green carpet? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! God covers the earth with soft green grass for us to play on! ⚽
hint: It grows in the park and garden.

question: What keeps us nice and warm in the cold winter? 🧣
explanation: Great job! The beautiful sun keeps us cozy and warm when it is cold! 🌞
hint: It shines from the sky during the day.

question: What looks exactly like tiny sparkling diamonds in the sky? 💎
explanation: Super! Stars sparkle so beautifully in the night sky! ⭐
hint: You only see them at night.

question: What do we read to quietly learn new and fun things? 📖
explanation: Fantastic! Reading books gives us wonderful stories and smart ideas! 💡
hint: They have pages with words and pictures.

question: What do we say right before happily going to sleep? 🛏️
explanation: Awesome! We say 'Good night' and thank God for a lovely day! 😴
hint: We say this when it is dark outside.

question: What two amazing things help little plants grow big? 🌱
explanation: Great job! Plants need warm sunshine and cool rain to grow tall! 🌻
hint: One gives light, the other gives water.

question: What do funny monkeys love to swing on? 🐒
explanation: Super! God gave monkeys long arms to swing happily on tree branches! 🌳
hint: They are part of tall trees.

question: What is our beautiful and wonderful world full of? ❤️
explanation: Wonderful! The world is filled with happy things to be thankful for! 🌍
hint: It makes us smile and feel good.

question: Who loves every little child very, very much? 👼
explanation: Awesome! God loves us all and gives us this beautiful world to enjoy! 🙏
hint: We pray to Him to say thank you.
